content.body: We had cancelled next week’s joint CSSWG/WHATWG/OpenUI task force meeting because of the CSSWG face-to-face at Mozilla Berlin, but I got a request to have a presentation on form controls styling in that meeting’s agenda. I’m slotting this at the regular joint meeting time (which happens to be at the last hour of the face-to-face). More details on dialing in and the presentation contents will come as I get them.
